title: Salesforce Multi-Touch Attribution and Revenue Reporting
ownership: Identified the attribution problem and owned the architecture, Flow design, scoring, deployment and iteration.
adoption: In production as a live ROI snapshot used to inform resource-allocation decisions.
summary: Designed, implemented and deployed a weighted Salesforce attribution system connecting recent email, event, sales and organisational engagement with enquiries, referrals, opportunities, placements and commercial decisions.
details: Built separate Salesforce Flow entry paths for Lead enquiries, Contact enquiries and Account-level referrals. The model used a three-week engagement window, Campaign Member activity, recognised organisational domains, MAT and Account context, returning-customer status and sequence-sensitive weighting. It normalised applicable channel influence to 100%, stored the result in a custom Attribution Model object and now supplies ROI snapshots for dashboards, revenue reports and resource allocation.
featuredMetric: Normalises applicable channel influence to 100% and puts the result into live commercial use.

title: Local-Authority Account Hierarchy, Contract Pricing and Commercial Risk
ownership: Advocated for the model and owned its design, automation, validation, deployment and continuing governance.
adoption: Production foundation for Local Authority relationships, pricing, segmentation and reporting.
summary: Designed a local-authority-centred Salesforce account model linking organisations, people, contracts, pricing and commercial exposure in a usable one-to-many structure.
details: Replaced operationally limited one-to-one views with a structure that surfaced all clients connected to each Local Authority. Custom Metadata Type-driven assignment, Salesforce Flow and validation rules maintained the hierarchy across Accounts, Leads and Contacts, while Contract data and Opportunity automation helped users find the correct bespoke charge rate and assess authority-level risk.
featuredMetric: Applied across 1,000+ Accounts and 20,000+ Leads and Contacts, representing 200+ local authorities.

title: MAT and Private Governing-Organisation Commercial Architecture
ownership: Defined the commercial model, designed the technical architecture and presented it for senior approval.
adoption: Formally adopted after approval from the Director and CEO; now shapes email marketing and account strategy.
summary: Modelled schools within their Multi-Academy Trust, independent-school-group and wider governing-organisation relationships, then operationalised those relationships across Salesforce and MCAE.
details: Mapped school Accounts to MATs and other private governing organisations, represented those relationships through additional parent structures and created custom lookup keys so unconverted Leads could retain organisational context. A dynamic multi-object Screen Flow, validation rules and Custom Metadata Type-driven exact and wildcard domain matching maintained the model. Purchase-triggered Salesforce Campaigns then used related buying activity as a signal for MCAE validation, grading, nurture and sales routing.
featuredMetric: Mapped approximately 50% of school Accounts to 215 MATs and private governing organisations.

title: Salesforce Lead Opportunity Forecasting and Automated Closure
ownership: Identified the process gap and owned solution design, build, deployment and live refinement.
adoption: Production sales workflow preserving repeated opportunity attempts and reportable outcomes.
summary: Built a pre-conversion Lead opportunity process that guided sales activity, calculated forecast value, preserved repeated attempts and closed inactive work automatically.
details: Created a guided Salesforce Screen Flow with four dependent progression stages covering identification, outreach, response and outcome. Forecast value used the previous 12 months of purchasing data, including organisation type, rate, weekly hours, service duration and MAT context. A dedicated custom object preserved every opportunity attempt while the Lead displayed only the current cycle, and scheduled automation closed inactive opportunities after 21 days while retaining user-recorded and system-generated outcomes for reporting.
featuredMetric: Used 12 months of purchasing data and automatically closed inactive opportunities after 21 days.

title: Salesforce Access Governance, Data Standards and User Adoption
ownership: Served as departmental Salesforce super user and feature owner, refining designs through user feedback.
adoption: Production features available to 30+ users; daily use concentrated in Development and Referrals.
summary: Governed access to Salesforce objects, fields and Flows while standardising CRM data and supporting company-wide feature adoption through testing, training and troubleshooting.
details: Configured permission sets, object permissions, field-level access and validation controls for custom functionality. Standardised Lead, Contact and Account data, tested changes across different access levels, resolved user issues and translated technical changes into practical documentation, training and coaching. Features were available across the company to 30+ users, with day-to-day use concentrated in two teams and occasional use by Education.
featuredMetric: Enabled governed access to production features across 30+ company users.

title: Commercial Systems Operating Model and Change Leadership
ownership: Defined and presented the relationship-led operating model across several senior-leadership meetings.
adoption: Approved first by the Director and then the CEO through the formal company process.
summary: Aligned sales, marketing, client services and operations around relationship-led commercial systems, clearer ownership, governed workflows and shared information.
details: Presented the model across several meetings, secured Director and CEO approval and translated the strategy into Salesforce and MCAE workflows, responsibilities, checkpoints and user guidance. Implementation combined senior-stakeholder communication, documentation, training, feedback and sustained adoption, changing how the company viewed interconnected Accounts and influencing email marketing and wider brand voice.
featuredMetric: Secured Director and CEO approval for a relationship-led commercial operating model.

title: Mailchimp-to-MCAE Migration, Data Remediation and Platform Rebuild
ownership: Led data remediation, platform design, migration controls, testing and production rollout.
adoption: Production foundation for the company's MCAE audiences and campaign operations.
summary: Led the transition from a high-risk Mailchimp and Pro-Net environment into a governed MCAE instance built largely from scratch.
details: Reviewed legacy records, duplication, consent risks and unusable data before rationalising the database and moving viable prospects into MCAE. Rebuilt the marketing-automation foundation around Salesforce integration, controlled audience management, consent and suppression rules, preference handling, send hygiene and repeatable campaign processes. The transition replaced fragmented practices with a more governed operating environment.
featuredMetric: Reduced approximately 30,000 legacy contacts to 19,000 viable prospects and improved successful-send rate to approximately 99%.

title: Initial MCAE Audience, Consent and Suppression Architecture
ownership: Designed and implemented the initial architecture, including list strategy, suppression, remediation and preference governance.
adoption: Completed in January 2026 and retained as the production foundation for three commercial audiences.
summary: Built the initial self-healing MCAE audience architecture covering qualification, suppression, preferences, remediation and Salesforce-informed segmentation.
details: Built approximately 400 MCAE lists, using dynamic lists for current prospect states and static micro-segmentation lists for historical actions. A fully dynamic Master Suppression List, preference and unsubscribe controls, missing-data remediation and merge-tag protection governed sendability. The completed architecture supported three commercial audiences spanning provision and services, community influence and professional development.
featuredMetric: Built approximately 400 MCAE lists within a governed, permission-aware audience architecture.

title: Ongoing MCAE Audience Governance and Predictive Qualification
ownership: Owns the production architecture after launch, monitoring, refining and extending its governance and qualification logic.
adoption: Live operating layer for audience eligibility, buyer qualification, exception review and re-engagement.
summary: Maintains and extends the MCAE audience system through reversible qualification, lifecycle controls, predictive buyer grading and human review of unresolved data.
details: Since February 2026, refined production rules for qualification, suppression, remediation, subscription governance and Salesforce-informed segmentation. Added time-based score resets, dynamic profile degradation, formal sub-profiles, known-inferred-unknown states, administrator review queues and proof-of-life journeys so historic activity and uncertain data do not become permanent commercial assumptions.
featuredMetric: Implemented reversible qualification, time-based score resets and human review for unresolved audience data.

title: Email Campaign Operations Across Mailchimp and MCAE
ownership: Sole owner of campaign operations and the sequencing of Pardot/MCAE work affecting channel continuity.
adoption: Live revenue-supporting channel using the same audience across the Mailchimp-to-MCAE transition.
summary: Owned campaign operations first through Mailchimp and then MCAE, maintaining the same audience through the Salesforce transition while improving performance and commercial visibility.
details: Planned, built and measured more than 50 campaigns across email, events, webinars and gated content. Mailchimp activity influenced approximately £419,475 in internally modelled revenue during 2025. After the audience moved to MCAE, average open rate increased from approximately 8% to 40%, the strongest campaign achieved an 84% open rate and MCAE-attributed activity recorded £127,642.98 in realised revenue from February through May 2026.
featuredMetric: Recorded approximately £127.6k in realised MCAE-attributed revenue from February to May 2026.

title: Modular MCAE XHTML Email Template System
ownership: Designed, tested and documented the framework, directing AI-assisted XHTML development and user training.
adoption: Adopted as the organisation's standard marketing-email production framework.
summary: Designed and delivered MCAE's standard modular email-production framework after the Mailchimp migration removed the previous drag-and-drop content-block workflow.
details: Analysed commercially successful Mailchimp layouts, translated recurring patterns into reusable modules and applied a consistent brand system across MCAE templates. Used AI-assisted XHTML generation alongside manual code review, Gmail and Outlook testing, security-conscious structures, documentation and user training. The framework was expanded incrementally as campaign requirements developed and became the standard production approach for recurring emails.
featuredMetric: Created approximately 13 reusable modules across 13 templates, supporting up to 48 combinations and reducing typical production from several days to approximately one day.

title: AI-Ready Salesforce, Pardot and Website-Automation Architecture
ownership: Designed and implemented governed data and automation foundations while defining the unfunded future state separately.
adoption: The data, Campaign and automation foundations are live; the proposed AI execution layer was not deployed.
summary: Built governed Salesforce and Pardot/MCAE data, Campaign, segmentation and website-handoff foundations designed to support future AI-assisted workflows.
details: Created structured Lead and Contact data models, Salesforce Campaign connections, journey-eligibility rules and segmentation pathways intended to provide future agents with governed commercial context. Zapier connected website activity and form submissions with Pardot/MCAE automations. A future agentic attribution enhancement was also designed, but no production AI model, agent or AI-driven attribution layer was deployed after funding for the required AI tokens was withdrawn.
featuredMetric: Completed the AI-ready data and automation foundations; the AI execution layer was not deployed.

title: Local-Authority Commercial Intelligence Application
ownership: Owned the project end to end from problem definition and scoring logic through deployment and live refinement.
adoption: Production decision-support application central to pricing, relationship and bid-prioritisation work.
summary: Built a custom Salesforce commercial-intelligence application that turned Local Authority, Account, Contract and Bid data into an actionable decision-support view.
details: Defined the requirements, data relationships, scoring logic and user workflow for an application that consolidated Local Authority relationships, Accounts, Bids, Referrals, Contracts and custom pricing. Directed AI-assisted Apex and component development with manual testing and validation. The production application surfaces one-to-many relationships, correct charge rates and bid win/loss evidence so limited effort can be prioritised where it is most likely to create value.
featuredMetric: Supports decisions across 200+ Local Authorities, 1,000+ Accounts and around 2,500 annual Bids.

title: AI-Assisted Newsletter Engagement and Privacy-Conscious Leaderboard
ownership: Created the product concept and owned requirements, AI-assisted build, testing, refinement and deployment.
adoption: Live within the Fresh Start newsletter; accessible through a free subscription.
summary: Designed, built, tested and deployed a web application that turned newsletter engagement into a visible, privacy-conscious participation experience.
details: Translated an engagement concept into a live newsletter application using structured prompting, iterative testing, debugging and interface refinement. The product incorporated privacy-conscious display names, ranking logic, consent and data-minimisation considerations, with GitHub used for version control and Vercel for deployment. It is now live within the Fresh Start newsletter behind a free subscription.
featuredMetric: Built and deployed a functioning application now live within the Fresh Start newsletter.

title: Community Strategy Framework and MCAE Thought Leadership
ownership: Founded the venture and independently researched, developed and published its frameworks and technical writing, with guidance from a mentor and adviser.
adoption: Published through the maintained DCC website; its relationship-led philosophy also informs employed systems work at Fresh Start in Education.
summary: Developed an original five-stage community funnel and community taxonomy, then translated the research into published community-strategy and MCAE thought leadership.
details: Reviewed more than 20 community-funnel models and conducted an expert interview with a financial representative with more than 20 years of experience. Synthesised the research into a five-stage funnel—Awareness, Interaction, Engagement, Buy-In and Advocacy—with trust and quality across every stage, plus a taxonomy of close, broad, digital and product communities. Published a seven-part community-strategy series and four MCAE papers while using engagement evidence to refine the work.
featuredMetric: Published a seven-part community-strategy series and four MCAE papers; the community framework drew on 20+ model reviews and an expert interview.

ownership: Owned the registration-to-follow-up workflow and its connection across campaigns, CRM and MCAE.
adoption: Production workflow used across events, webinars and segmented follow-up journeys.
summary: Connected event and webinar promotion, registration, attendance and follow-up with Salesforce Campaigns and MCAE audience journeys.
details: Structured the lifecycle from invitation and registration through attendance capture, Salesforce Campaign membership, CRM visibility and segmented MCAE follow-up. featuredMetric: Supported email activity for 8 events and 2 webinars, including invitations, promotion and live Zoom operation or hosting.

title: Youth Programme Revitalisation, Audience Growth and Cost Control
ownership: Owned departmental event strategy, programme delivery, marketing, volunteer development and budget control.
adoption: Delivered as the department's operating model across in-person, digital and hybrid programmes from 2022 to February 2024.
summary: Revitalised youth events and community programmes through stronger programming, grassroots marketing, partnership development and operational control.
details: Reviewed the programme portfolio, improved the relevance and consistency of events, strengthened grassroots promotion and built relationships with participants, families and partner organisations. Led 10 rotating established volunteers and recruited and trained nine additional junior volunteers. Combined audience development with operational planning and annual budget control to create sustained growth rather than treating each event as an isolated activity.

adoption: Held broad delegated conference authority with six regular direct reports and peak oversight of approximately 450 people through team leaders.
summary: Managed the planning and live delivery of large, multi-day international conferences across access, volunteers, participant services, VIP operations and risk controls.
details: Progressed from Operations Team Member in 2017 to Operations Co-Manager in 2018 and Event Operations Manager from 2019 to July 2021.
